title: Hoshino Ichika — Leo/need〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy - Class 1-C

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Sigh...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
(Classes are really dragging on today...
We finally have a band going, so I'd rather be practicing.)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (English class is so boring...)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I have a question!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (That's Saki...)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Could you tell me what this word here means?

rows.Speaker: Teacher
rows.Line: It depends on the context. Here it would be...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Oh, I get it now!
Thank you!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (She seems to be genuinely enjoying the lesson.)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (I wish I could have as much fun at school as Saki...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (But it's not like wishing for it will change anything. It only makes me feel more frustrated.)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (Maybe I should express my feelings through a song.)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (I'll give it a try.)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (Great! I finally caught up with the rest of the class!)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (I can go to our rehearsal with a clear conscience today, without feeling bad about having fun when I should be studying... Huh?)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (Ichi's furiously writing something in her notebook. She seemed to be spacing out until just a moment ago?)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (But it doesn't look like she's copying from the blackboard.)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
(Is she doodling?
Nah, she's too focused on whatever it is.)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (Hmm, I think I know what she's up to!)

rows.Speaker: Teacher
rows.Line: Okay, class. That's it for today.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (Alright... I got the rough idea down on paper.)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
(Now it just needs some polishing.
I'll have to think of words which express my feelings more accurately.)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hah, I knew it! You were writing song lyrics!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Whoa! What on earth, Saki?!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I saw you scribbling something in class, and you had this focused look in your eyes, so I guessed it was a song you were writing. Teehee, bingo!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Show me what you wrote!
What is it about?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: You can read it but... Don't laugh, okay?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I wouldn't!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: What have we got here... The unbearable ennui of English?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Uh, don't read it out loud!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Clock hands, don't be sluggish, make it finish... Aah, I see you went for a rhyme there?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: That's enough!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hey, don't hide your notes! I'm not done reading!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Not my problem! You've seen enough!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Why are you being like that? We might perform this song with our band one day. Who knows. Don't be shy!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Forget it! This is just a draft.
I'll show you the finished version once it's ready.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: So just drop it for now, okay?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Have it your way...
Don't keep me waiting too long for the good-to-go version!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Sigh...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: You know what...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Curiosity's killing me right now! I HAVE to read it! Gimme!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Hands off it, Saki!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Where were we? Gazing out the window with melancholy...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Not out loud, Saki!
